rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 1 'It found what you asked it to look for' expand-view L7 'Your look-for line told the agent what counted as a finding' -- 'look-for line' is not named earlier in this file, but it is arc-earned spine vocabulary (apt101-read-the-digest phases 3-4 and the Day 1 look-for beat, grep confirmed) so the carve-out applies; harm (reader cannot resolve a referent) absent. Slide 6 'The blur' resolves to chunk 5 header 'About the future, all was blurry' (immediate continuation).

grep -nEi 'opening lecture|earlier lecture|last lecture|previous' over the 7 slide files -> 0 hits. Closest: L9 (slide 2/1) 'Open your agreed list of sources' names a document the student holds, by name not position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 1 L7 'Turned round, the same material usually gave you a second headline' -> apt101-read-the-digest.md L60 'run your digest once more from the same brief, with only your look-for line turned round' exists; 'your agreed list of sources' -> exercises/apt101-what-goes-in.md exists; 'your brief' -> same. No dead beat reference.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no live-demo, guess-before-reveal or terminal cue in any chunk; muted read finds only verbed prose

rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 4 'I wanted to be right' (3 sentences, L40-42) -- still carries a self-carrying claim (being right was progress; being wrong was failure) that chunk 6's header answers; deliberate essay beat, not a wait-state.

Closest: chunk 7 header 'The instructions are one suspect; your question is another' over three bullets (material, instructions, question) -- header names two of three suspects, true as a summary, the material bullet does not contradict it. Chunk 6 header 'Being wrong does not diminish you' is stated verbatim at L64.

Closest: chunk 1 L7 'A line that asked for support got support. A line that asked about what customers do got behaviour... A line that asked both ways still chose...' -- anaphora triple, but the third leg carries new content (the both-ways case still chooses), so stays inside; chunk 3 L31 'A team that tests... A team that ships... A digest that agrees...' third leg also new. No 'Not X. Not Y. Z.', no self-grading superlative (grep 'most useful|best|key' -> none), no number+retraction, no empty verb triplet (L18 'counted mentions, grouped themes and ranked them' each concrete).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep for compendium|forcing function|surface (noun)|firing|beat|mood over the 7 slide bodies -> 0 hits in body. 'look-for line', 'digest', 'feature factory', 'headline' are the training's and product teams' own words, not maintainer dialect.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' over the 7 slide bodies above their maintainer tails -> 0; no bold at all, inside the budget.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture is included by whats-actually-true.md L32 '[Lecture: Why it agreed](lectures/apt101-why-it-agreed.md)' as a standalone-paragraph include; expand-md inlines all 7 slides; node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file reports slides: 7. Not rendered in both layouts this session, so deck presence rests on the standard include shape.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js -> 'OK -- 55 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent'; no Phase N / N. headers in this file, no hand-numbered positions.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js -> 'OK -- 55 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut'; grep -nEi 'above|below|earlier|previous' over the 7 slides -> 0 hits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no in-body links; only structural include links on the lecture manifest, which the rule excludes

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/lectures/apt101-why-it-agreed.md -> 'slides: 7 limits: 210 words / 6 bullets oversized: 0'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture headings are claims: 'It found what you asked it to look for', 'A faster feature factory is still a feature factory', 'Being wrong does not diminish you'. Closest: 'About the future, all was blurry' is narrative-voice rather than a law, but it is a catalogue/essay beat header, not a law or consolidation slide, so the claim requirement does not bind.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 1 L11 'The headline came from your question as much as from your customers.' -- reads as a kicker beside the header 'It found what you asked it to look for', but it adds the customer-side half (the headline is the product of question AND customers) that the header and L7 do not carry, so it earns the slot. Chunk 7 L81 'Ask the agent to make this diagnosis first. Then rerun only the smallest step' adds a move no neighbour holds. Chunk 6 L68 ties the narrator's passage to the digest; no doctrine restatement.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Header changes found in git: sources-instructions-reach was 'Find which part went wrong before fixing anything', now 'The instructions are one suspect; your question is another'; ship-the-ideas-discover-the-wrongs was 'I used to think of being wrong as failure', now 'Being wrong does not diminish you'. Cover-the-body test: chunk 7 bullets (material / instructions / your question) answer the new header, and L75 'before changing anything' still serves it; chunk 6's body states the header at L64 and the 'make something in an hour' bridge (L62) is not repeated by any neighbour. No inherited bullet answers only the old header, and the old 'failure' line now lives on chunk 4 L42, not duplicated.

notes: Lines cited are against the expand-md view (the raw file is a manifest of 7 slide includes; wording lives in curriculum/slides/*.md). Slide-file wording/backing are judged in the slide files; first-person narrator on chunks 4-6 is maintainer-attested essay voice, 'Antti Tevanlinna' signature mid-chunk 6 is an attributed quote line. Cross-class: chunk 1 L7 final sentence ('what came back came from the questions your material asked') is dense for writing class.
